title_en: Announcement of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on No Longer Prosecuting Criminal Acts Committed by Personnel Who Went to Taiwan After the Establishment of the People's Republic of China but Before the Establishment of Local People's Regimes

articles.content_en: I. With respect to crimes committed by personnel who went to Taiwan after the founding of the People's Republic of China and before the establishment of the local people's political power at the place of crime, no prosecution shall be initiated.

II. Where personnel who went to Taiwan commit crimes after the founding of the People's Republic of China and before the establishment of the local people's political power at the place of crime, and such crimes are continuous or continue until after the establishment of the local people's political power, the limitation period for prosecution shall be calculated from the date on which the criminal act ends. Where the provisions of Article 76 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China are satisfied, no prosecution shall be initiated. Where the statutory maximum penalty is life imprisonment or death penalty, if twenty years have elapsed, no prosecution shall be initiated either. If it is deemed that prosecution must be initiated, such prosecution shall be approved by the Supreme People's Procuratorate.

III. With respect to crimes committed by personnel who went to regions and countries other than Taiwan before the founding of the People's Republic of China, or after the founding of the People's Republic of China and before the establishment of the local people's political power at the place of crime, the matter shall be handled respectively in accordance with the spirit of the Announcement of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on No Longer Prosecuting the Criminal Acts of Personnel Who Went to Taiwan Before the Founding of the People's Republic of China and the provisions of Articles I and II of this Announcement.
